facts.fact: The minister states the Cyber Security Authority operates a CERT-GH, which handled incidents in January-June 2026 (published 2026-09-07).
The Cyber Security Authority's CERT-GH responded to 3,363 cybersecurity incidents between January and June 2026.
Vulnerability assessments were completed for 25 Critical Information Infrastructure institutions across education, health, public administration, security and utilities in January-June 2026.
The minister reported CERT-GH responded to 3,363 incidents for January-June 2026.
